name: GitHub stars
description: Stars on the benchmark's primary repository at the time of observation.

name: Paper citations
description: Citations of the primary paper as counted by the named source (OpenAlex or Semantic Scholar).

name: Pass rate
aggregation: Passing attempts divided by the denominator, across all tasks and repetitions.
denominator: Planned attempts. Each run must state how missing or incomplete attempts were counted.

name: pass^k
aggregation: Share of tasks where all k independent trials succeed.
denominator: Tasks. k is recorded in the run's repetitions.
